svg.title: A cstack workspace
svg.desc: A workspace window titled your-studio / cstack. On the left, the brand files in git: brand-system.json marked LOCKED, rules, tokens, gold and anti references, a brief, and the state logs. Claude, Codex, a designer and the owner each work on a different file. In the middle, a Klein blue launch poster is in preview. Under it, a review strip: on-brand passed, correct passed, culturally alive passed, owner decision waiting.
